fusions.name: Drumfoot
fusions.desc: Stamps the head down, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Sprint Smash
fusions.desc: You sprint up to 7 tiles at the target; the blow deals 14 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Flushed Out
fusions.desc: A burst of movement that carries you 5 tiles forward. For 4 seconds after using it you move 25% faster.

fusions.name: Running Start
fusions.desc: After you cover enough ground, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
